caveats: Secondary and descriptive: no decision rule, no hypothesis.
Both TrueFake real pools are Flickr, the platform of our training reals, so neither supports an FPR claim; FORLAB's FPR is reported descriptively only.
StyleGAN fakes are faces, so StyleGAN vs FFHQ is the content-matched comparison; any comparison against FORLAB also reflects content.
The platforms downscale (720/1200 px wide, <= 800 px tall), so the fixed 320 centre crop covers a different extent of the scene pre- and post-share.
FFHQ is non-commercial and FORLAB's terms are NOT-VERIFIED: no deployment claim (CLAUDE.md section 6c).

Twitter left most StableDiffusion1.5 / StableDiffusion2 fakes byte-identical to their pre-share file (counted in twitter_identical): their Twitter Delta is near zero, not exactly zero, because the reals were re-encoded.

bootstrap.paired: one id draw per group per resample, shared by every share and model; reals within their pool, fakes within their slice

forlab_fpr_at_k0_union_threshold.note: descriptive only, never a claim (both pools are Flickr)
